candidates.claim: Telnet is enabled on fw-01 for source 10.10.10.0/24 on the ot interface, but the management policy states that Telnet must not be enabled anywhere and that device management is allowed only from MGMT.
candidates.remediation: Remove the telnet mgmt_access entry for 10.10.10.0/24 on fw-01 and restrict device management to MGMT 10.10.99.0/24 on the mgmt interface.

candidates.claim: The telnet 10.10.10.0 line on fw-01 is a deviation from the approved baseline (change added, section global) and must be reported for reconciliation.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the telnet 10.10.10.0 line with the approved baseline by removing it or documenting an approved exception.
